data_type: SYNTHETIC; actual C controllers and wire codec
scope: GM Pitch development diagnosis; fixed gains, seeds 5300-5302; no tuning or new holdout claim

comparison_contract.flags: Only original soft/hard limit and slew flags map to bits 0 and 1
comparison_contract.integral: Config k_integral maps directly; use zero for the primary comparison
comparison_contract.nonfinite_policy: Do not filter original inputs or outputs

hypotheses: If quantization hides gravity benefits, removing quantization alone changes the paired result more than removing noise alone.
If integral and ESO overlap, their fixed on/off factorial changes the gravity benefit.
If command/actuator timing is contaminating disturbance estimates, removing each delay separately changes the result.
